title: 17230 - 17230/P0846
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri issues to/from pressure sensor (G194)
Malfunctioning Valve Body or pressure sensor (G194)
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  transmission fluid level and pressure
Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri issues to/from pressure sensor (G194) when applicable
Kontrol edin:  for TSBs and TPIs for know Mechatronic unit flash updates and revised parts
Kontrol edin:  Valve Body and/or pressure sensor (G194) when applicable
technicalNotes: G194 was installed in NAR market Golf based vehicles such as the (1Y) Beetle Convertible with the 6-Speed Automatic Transmission (09G) manufactured prior to June 2004.  When applicable, G194 is used to verify B-2 clutch activation.
model: Cayenne, Macan, Panamera, 911, Taycan, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, Q3, Q5, Q7, Q8, Leon, Ibiza, Ateca, Arona, Tarraco, Octavia, Superb, Kodiaq, Karoq, Fabia, Scala, Passat, Golf, Jetta, Tiguan, Polo, Arteon, Touareg, Transporter, Caddy, Amarok, Scirocco
